text_en: And the fifth angel blew his trumpet, and I saw a star that had fallen from heaven to earth, and he was given the key to the shaft of the bottomless pit;
text_cn: 第五位天使一吹号角，我看见有一颗星从天上落到地上；并给了他深渊洞穴的钥匙。

text_en: he opened the shaft of the bottomless pit, and from the shaft rose smoke like the smoke of a great furnace, and the sun and the air were darkened with the smoke from the shaft.
text_cn: 他一开了深渊的洞穴，就有烟从洞穴里冒上来，像大火窑里的烟，太阳和天空都因那洞穴里的烟昏暗了，

text_en: Then from the smoke came locusts on the earth, and they were given authority like the authority of scorpions of the earth.
text_cn: 遂有蝗虫从烟里，来到地上；又赋给了它们，好似地上的蝎子具有的权柄。

text_en: They were told not to damage the grass of the earth or any green growth or any tree, but only those people who do not have the seal of God on their foreheads.
text_cn: 且吩咐它们不可伤害地上的草：凡青物，凡树木都不可伤害，只可伤害那些在额上没有天主印号的人；

text_en: They were allowed to torture them for five months, but not to kill them, and their torture was like the torture of a scorpion when it stings someone.
text_cn: 并且吩咐蝗虫不可杀死他们，但要使他们受痛苦五个月，他们所受的痛苦，就如人被蝎子螫着时所受的痛苦。

text_en: And in those days people will seek death but will not find it; they will long to die, but death will flee from them.
text_cn: 在那日期内，人求死而不得；渴望死，死却离开他们。

text_en: In appearance the locusts were like horses equipped for battle. On their heads were what looked like crowns of gold; their faces were like human faces,
text_cn: 蝗虫的形状仿佛准备上阵的战马，它们的头上好似有像黄金的荣冠，面貌有如人的面貌；

text_en: their hair like women’s hair, and their teeth like lions’ teeth;
text_cn: 它们的头发好似女人的头发，牙好似狮子的牙；

text_en: they had scales like iron breastplates, and the noise of their wings was like the noise of many chariots with horses rushing into battle.
text_cn: 它们的胸甲有如铁甲，它们翅膀的响声，有如许多马车奔驰上阵的响声；

text_en: They have tails like scorpions, with stingers, and in their tails is their power to harm people for five months.
text_cn: 它们有相似蝎子的尾和刺；它们的尾能伤害世人，五个月之久。

text_en: They have as king over them the angel of the bottomless pit; his name in Hebrew is Abaddon, and in Greek he is called Apollyon.
text_cn: 它们以深渊的使者为它们的王子，他的名字，希伯来文叫“阿巴冬”，希腊文叫“阿颇隆”。

text_en: The first woe has passed. There are still two woes to come.
text_cn: 第一种灾祸过去了，看，还有两种灾祸随后而来。

text_en: Then the sixth angel blew his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God,
text_cn: 第六位天使一吹了号角，我听见有一种声音，由天主前的金祭坛四角发出，

text_en: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Release the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates. ”
text_cn: 向那持有号角的第六位天使说：“放开那在幼发拉的大河所捆着的四位天使罢！”

text_en: So the four angels were released, who had been held ready for the hour, the day, the month, and the year, to kill a third of humankind.
text_cn: 于是那四位天使被放开了；他们已准备于某年、某月、某日、某时，把世人杀死三分之一。

text_en: The number of the troops of cavalry was two hundred million; I heard their number.
text_cn: 那马队的数目共有两万万；我也听见了他们的这个数目。

text_en: And this was how I saw the horses in my vision: the riders wore breastplates the color of fire and of sapphire and of sulfur; the heads of the horses were like lions’ heads, and fire and smoke and sulfur came out of their mouths.
text_cn: 我在异像中看见的马和骑马的是这样：他们穿着火红、紫青和硫磺色的铠甲；马头像狮子头，从它们的口中射出火、烟和硫磺。

text_en: By these three plagues a third of humankind was killed, by the fire and smoke and sulfur coming out of their mouths.
text_cn: 由于从它们口中所射出的火、烟和硫磺这三种灾害，世人被杀死了三分之一。

text_en: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails; their tails are like serpents, having heads; and with them they inflict harm.
text_cn: 马的能力就在它们的口和它们的尾上；它们的尾相似蛇，并且有害人的头。

text_en: The rest of humankind, who were not killed by these plagues, did not repent of the works of their hands or give up worshiping demons and idols of gold and silver and bronze and stone and wood, which cannot see or hear or walk.
text_cn: 可是，其余没有被这灾害杀死的人，仍然没有悔改，离开他们手所作的，仍旧去崇拜邪魔和那看不见，听不见，走不动的金、银、铜、石、木神像；

text_en: And they did not repent of their murders or their sorceries or their fornication or their thefts.
text_cn: 他们也没有悔改，放弃各种凶杀、邪术、奸淫和偷窃。
